questions.question: In triangle ABC, the measure of angle A is 47° and the measure of angle B is 60°. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle C?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: B

The angles of a triangle add up to 180°: 180 − 47 − 60 = 73.

questions.skill: Ratios, rates, proportional relationships, and units
questions.question: A printer prints 4 pages every 40 seconds. At this rate, how many pages does the printer print in 12 minutes?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: D

12 minutes = 720 seconds, which is 18 groups of 40 seconds. 18 × 4 = 72 pages.

questions.skill: Nonlinear equations in one variable and systems of equations in two variables
questions.question: If (x − 5)2 = 9 and x > 5, what is the value of x?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: B

Take square roots: x − 5 = 3 (positive because x > 5), so x = 8.

questions.question: If 9x + 4 = 31, what is the value of x?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: B

Subtract 4 from both sides: 9x = 27. Divide by 9: x = 3.

questions.question: A rectangle has an area of 319 square centimeters and a width of 11 centimeters. What is the perimeter of the rectangle, in centimeters?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: C

Length = 319 ÷ 11 = 29. Perimeter = 2(29 + 11) = 80.

questions.question: A climbing gym charges a one-time membership fee of $40 plus $22 for each visit. A member has paid $436 in total for the membership fee and visits. How many visits has the member paid for?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: 18

Set up 40 + 22n = 436. Then 22n = 396, so n = 18.

questions.question: A line in the xy-plane passes through the points (2, 4) and (5, 0). What is the slope of the line?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: -4/3

Slope = (change in y) ÷ (change in x) = (0 − 4) ÷ (5 − 2) = −43.

questions.question: The number of users of a new app doubles every 4 weeks. The initial number of users is 200. Which function gives the number of users P after w weeks?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: D

The starting value 200 is multiplied by 2 once every 4 weeks, so after w weeks it has been multiplied w/4 times.

questions.question:
The graph of the linear function f is shown.

Which equation defines f?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: A

The line crosses the y-axis at (0, −3), so the y-intercept is −3. From (0, −3) to (2, 1) the slope is 4 ÷ 2 = 2.

questions.skill: Nonlinear equations in one variable and systems of equations in two variables
questions.question: What value of x satisfies the equation √x + 15 = 7?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: B

Square both sides: x + 15 = 49, so x = 34. Check: √49 = 7.

questions.question:
The table shows three values of x and their corresponding values of f(x), where f is a linear function.

What is the value of f(11)?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: C

The slope is (7 − 1) ÷ (0 − (−1)) = 6, and f(0) = 7. So f(x) = 6x + 7 and f(11) = 73.

questions.question:
The scatterplot shows data for 14 observations and a line of best fit.

The line of best fit has the equation y = 2x + 10. Based on the line of best fit, what is the predicted value of y when x = 4?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: D

Substitute x = 4: y = 2(4) + 10 = 18.

questions.question: The number of members of a club is modeled by the function f(t) = 1,600(1.2)t, where f(t) is the number of members t years after the start. What is the value of f(2)?

questions.skill: Nonlinear equations in one variable and systems of equations in two variables
questions.question: What is the solution to the equation 12x = 40x + 7?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: 3

Cross-multiply: 12(x + 7) = 40x, so 84 = 28x and x = 3.

questions.question: A school store sells small notebooks for $8 each and large notebooks for $10 each. The equation 8a + 10b = 128 represents a day on which $128 was collected from a small notebooks and b large notebooks. If 4 large notebooks were sold that day, how many small notebooks were sold?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: A

Substitute b = 4: 8a + 40 = 128, so 8a = 88 and a = 11.

questions.question:
For the polynomial function p, the table shows some values of x and their corresponding values of p(x).

Which of the following must be a factor of p(x)?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: C

Because p(5) = 0, 5 is a zero of p, so by the factor theorem x − 5 is a factor of p(x).

questions.skill: Evaluating statistical claims: observational studies and experiments
questions.question: Researchers selected 60 office workers at random from a large population and randomly assigned half of them to use a daily stretching routine and the other half not to. The group that used a daily stretching routine showed a significant improvement in reported back pain. Which conclusion is best supported?
options: Using a daily stretching routine likely causes an improvement in reported back pain for office workers in the population.
There is a relationship between a daily stretching routine and reported back pain, but no conclusion about cause can be drawn.
The results apply only to the 60 office workers in the study.
Using a daily stretching routine causes an improvement in reported back pain for anyone, including people outside the population.
questions.correct: Using a daily stretching routine likely causes an improvement in reported back pain for office workers in the population.
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: A

Random assignment supports a cause-and-effect conclusion, and random selection allows the result to be generalized to the population the sample came from, but not beyond it.

questions.question: Line p is defined by 3x + 5y = 3. Line q is perpendicular to line p in the xy-plane. What is the slope of line q?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: C

Write line p in slope-intercept form: y = −35x + 35, so its slope is −35. Perpendicular slopes are negative reciprocals: 53.

questions.question: In isosceles triangle PQR, PQ = PR, and the measure of angle P is 86°. Side QR is extended past R to point S. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle PRS?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: D

The base angles are equal: (180 − 86) ÷ 2 = 47°. Angle PRS is supplementary to angle PRQ: 180 − 47 = 133°.

questions.skill: Nonlinear equations in one variable and systems of equations in two variables
questions.question: In the equation x2 + kx + 16 = 0, k is a positive constant. If the equation has exactly one real solution, what is the value of k?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: 8

A quadratic has exactly one real solution when its discriminant is 0: k2 − 4(1)(16) = 0, so k2 = 64 and k = 8.

questions.skill: Systems of two linear equations in two variables
questions.question: The graphs of y = 5x + 8 and y = −4x + 8 intersect at the point (a, b) in the xy-plane. What is the value of a + b?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: 8

Set the expressions equal: 5x + 8 = −4x + 8, so x = 0. Then y = 8, and a + b = 8.

questions.skill: Nonlinear equations in one variable and systems of equations in two variables
questions.question: What is the sum of the solutions to 2x2 + 7x + 3 = 0?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: A

For ax2 + bx + c = 0, the sum of the solutions is −b/a = −72.

questions.question: Which expression is equivalent to (5x + 6)(x − 2)?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: C

Multiply each term: 5x · 1x = 5x2, the middle terms give -10x + (6x) = −4x, and 6 · −2 = −12.

questions.question: The functions f and g are defined by f(x) = −2x + 1 and g(x) = x2 + 3. What is the value of f(g(−1))?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: A

First g(−1) = −12 + 3 = 4. Then f(4) = −2(4) + 1 = −7.

questions.question: In triangle ABC, point D lies on AB and point E lies on AC so that DE is parallel to BC. If AD = 7, DB = 8, and DE = 21, what is the length of BC?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: B

Triangles ADE and ABC are similar, so BC/DE = AB/AD = 15/7. BC = 21 × 15/7 = 45.

questions.question:
The graph of y = f(x) is shown.

Which equation could define f?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: D

The vertex is (−3, 4) and the parabola opens upward, so f(x) = (x + 3)2 + 4.

questions.skill: Systems of two linear equations in two variables
questions.question:
5x − 4y = 24
3x + y = 28

If (x, y) is the solution to the system of equations above, what is the value of x?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: C

Solve by elimination or substitution: the solution is x = 8, y = 4. So x = 8.

questions.skill: Nonlinear equations in one variable and systems of equations in two variables
questions.question: What is the greater solution of the equation x2 − 2x − 48 = 0?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: 8

The equation factors as (x + 6)(x − 8) = 0, so x = −6 or x = 8. The greater solution is 8.

questions.skill: Systems of two linear equations in two variables
questions.question: A library bought a total of 48 books: paperback books costing $9 each and hardcover books costing $14 each. The total cost was $567. How many hardcover books were there?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: 27

Let s and l be the numbers of paperback books and hardcover books. Then s + l = 48 and 9s + 14l = 567. Multiply the first equation by 9 and subtract: 5l = 135, so l = 27.

questions.skill: Systems of two linear equations in two variables
questions.question:
6x + 7y = 8
rx + 28y = 39

In the system of equations above, r is a constant. If the system has no solution, what is the value of r?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: B

A system of two linear equations has no solution when the lines are parallel: the coefficients of x and y are proportional but the constants are not. The y-coefficient is multiplied by 4, so r = 6 × 4 = 24 (and 8 × 4 = 32 ≠ 39).

questions.skill: Inference from sample statistics and margin of error
questions.question: A random sample of the employees of a large company was surveyed, and 45% of those surveyed said they support a new park. The margin of error for the estimate is 2 percentage points at a 95% confidence level. Which of the following is the most appropriate conclusion?
options: It is plausible that between 43% and 47% of all employees of a large company support the new park.
Between 43% and 47% of the people in the sample support the new park.
It is plausible that between 41% and 45% of all employees of a large company support the new park.
Exactly 45% of all employees of a large company support the new park.
questions.correct: It is plausible that between 43% and 47% of all employees of a large company support the new park.
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: A

A margin of error gives a plausible range for the population value: the estimate plus or minus the margin.

questions.question: In the equation 2x + b = 2(x + 6) + 1, b is a constant. If the equation has infinitely many solutions, what is the value of b?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: C

Expand the right side: 2x + 12 + 1 = 2x + 13. The equation is true for every x only when b = 13.

questions.question: The expression (2x + 3)2 is equivalent to 4x2 + kx + 9, where k is a constant. What is the value of k?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: D

(a + b)2 = a2 + 2ab + b2, so k = 2(2)(3) = 12.

questions.question: Cylinder A has radius 3 and height 9. Cylinder B has radius 9 and height 9. The volume of cylinder B is how many times the volume of cylinder A?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: D

Volume = πr2h. Multiplying the radius by 3 multiplies the volume by 32 = 9.

questions.question: If 256x + 4 = 4x + 25, what is the value of x?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: 3

Write both sides as powers of 4: 44(x + 4) = 4x + 25. So 4(x + 4) = x + 25, which gives x = 3.

questions.skill: Linear inequalities in one or two variables
questions.question: What is the greatest integer value of x that satisfies the inequality 5x − 17 < 42?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: 11

Add 17: 5x < 59. Divide by 5: x < 595. The greatest integer less than 595 is 11.

questions.question: In the equation 2x + k = 4x + 20, k is a constant. If x = 4 is the solution to the equation, what is the value of k?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: A

Substitute x = 4: 8 + k = 36, so k = 28.

questions.question: For x ≠ 6, the expression x2 − 36x − 6 is equivalent to g(x). What is the value of g(13)?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: B

x2 − 36 = (x + 6)(x − 6), so g(x) = x + 6 and g(13) = 19.

questions.question: In right triangle ABC, angle C is a right angle, BC = 8, AC = 15, and AB = 17. What is the value of cos A?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: B

cos A = AC/AB = 1517 (SOH-CAH-TOA, measured from angle A).

questions.question: The value of a printing machine was $23,000 when it was new and decreases by $1,600 each year. After how many years will the value of the printing machine be $16,600?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: A

Solve 23000 − 1600t = 16600: 1600t = 6400, so t = 4.

questions.question: Line k is defined by y = 3x + 4. Line j is parallel to line k and passes through the point (−1, 9). What is the y-intercept of line j?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: D

Parallel lines have equal slopes, so line j is y = 3x + b. Substituting (−1, 9): 9 = 3(−1) + b, so b = 12.

questions.question: The function f is defined by f(x) = x2 − 4x + 20. What is the minimum value of f(x)?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: 16

Complete the square: f(x) = (x − 2)2 + 16. The minimum value occurs at x = 2 and equals 16.

questions.skill: Ratios, rates, proportional relationships, and units
questions.question: Water flows into a pool at a rate of 25 liters per minute. How many liters of water flow into the pool in 5 hours?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: 7500

5 hours = 300 minutes; 300 × 25 = 7,500 liters.

questions.question:
The table shows how a group of commuters traveled on a set of trips, by day type.

If one of the weekend trips is selected at random, what is the probability that the train was chosen?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: C

There are 46 weekend trips, and the train was chosen on 32 of them: 1623.
